correctness.rationale: The exact Pauli trace identity translates two complex tight qubit layers into two zero-centroid unit Bloch-vector sets with fixed paired inner products. Their concatenated 7-column-index Gram matrix is (2N/(N-1))(I-J/N), of rank N-1, proving N<=7. Each N=2,...,7 has an explicit exact trigonometric construction. For N=7 the six coordinate columns are mutually orthogonal with squared norm 7/3 and span the mean-zero subspace. In any extremal solution, A=(3/7)UU^T and B=(3/7)VV^T are positive contractions dominated by P=I-J/7, each rank 3 and trace 3; hence they are complementary orthogonal projections. This forces U^TU=V^TV=(7/3)I and U^TV=0. The saved standard-library verifier passed 229 additional floating-point checks, but finite checks are not used for universal claims.

originality.rationale: The motivating 2026 primary paper introduces SUNTFs, proves the sharp necessary stratified Gerzon bound, and constructs N=5 with two layers, but its seven-element harmonic and Gauss-sum constructions use six or seven layers, not two. Our all-N threshold and complementary seven-vector two-design realization establish sharp attainability where its general rank argument is merely necessary. The 2021 ECTFF work addresses Naimark-spatial equivalences; its abstract does not imply the more restrictive two-layer qubit construction. Targeted published-finding corpus semantic record searches and exact-parameter web searches showed no matching implication; this is best-knowledge originality, with residual older-work risk.

value.rationale: For the smallest complex two-layer nontrivial frame dimension, the newly introduced Gerzon bound says N<=7 but does not establish attainability. An explicit saturating N=7 construction together with a complete existence threshold N=2,...,7 fills that natural sharpness gap. The equality case forces complementary spherical two-designs and provides a new rigidity phenomenon, with an immediate seven-plane equichordal filter-bank application in C^4. In the real setting the corresponding cap is N=5, so this also quantifies the arithmetic/field distinction in low-dimensional optimal subspace packings.
